text: Hi, I bought a desk lamp on 20 Sep and it flickers. Can I return it for a refund?

raw.reply: Hello Daniel, I am so sorry to hear that your new desk lamp is flickering. Since your item is faulty and within the 30-day return window, you can absolutely return it for a full refund of ₹1,899. Once we pick up the lamp, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 5–7 working days.
